profile_text.body:
Andreessen Horowitz, which also goes by a16z, is a venture capital firm based in Menlo Park, California, and founded in 2009. On its website the firm describes itself as a venture capital firm in Silicon Valley, California, investing in bold founders, innovators, and entrepreneurs building the future through technology. The site also carries the phrase "Software Is Eating the World."

The firm is not tracked as the maker of AI products of its own, and no MCP servers are attributed to it, so its position in AI is that of an investor rather than a vendor. Its recorded legal exposure is in California, with 281 cases.
